items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I joined Eli Rice again because Bert Bailey was playing with him and he got sick.

ctx.x: When I was talking before and saying I met Eli Rice in Menocwa, Wisconsin, that was 1928. And they took our band to Milwaukee. He asked me did I play the clarinet and I told him yes, but I had never played it before. So he took me to the store and bought me a metal clarinet. And I played it the way Lester Young played the clarinet, you know.
Were metal clarinets more common those days?
